content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Visakhapatnam Port Authority Fire Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.vpt.shipping.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Visakhapatnam Port Authority for filling up vacant positions under their establishment in Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Fire Officer under the Visakhapatnam Port Authority recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Fire Officer position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for Visakhapatnam Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Offline. Candidates must send their filled application forms to the designated official address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the offline application form is 28-10-2026. Ensure applications reach before this date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Fire Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Fire Officer post must be between 18 to 40 Years of age as per the notification criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate from recognized University / Institution with 6 months training in Fire Training Institute / College and hold a driving license.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Fire Officer post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send my completed application form?
faq.answer: Send applications to: SECRETARY, 1st Floor, Administrative Office Building, Visakhapatnam Port Authority, Visakhapatnam-530035 through appropriate postal channels.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website for updates?
faq.answer: You can check the official website of Visakhapatnam Port Authority at www.vpt.shipping.gov.in for all future recruitment updates and notices.
